tasks.title: Add ToolCalls and ToolResultBytes counters to agentrun.Result and count them in Runner.run
steps: Write TS-13-1 (Result field types), TS-13-2 (trace counts calls and bytes), TS-13-3 (blocked call increments ToolCalls only), TS-13-4 (error result increments both), TS-13-5 (zero calls yields nil maps), and TS-13-38 (property test) and confirm they fail.
Add `ToolCalls map[string]int` and `ToolResultBytes map[string]int64` fields to the `Result` struct in `internal/agentrun/phase.go`.
In `Runner.run`, add a `toolCallCounter` struct (similar to `toolErrorCounter`) with thread-safe maps for per-tool call counts and byte sums. Initialize it before the event loop.

In the `trace` method's `core.ToolResultEvent` case, always increment the call counter for `v.Message.ToolName`. If the call was not blocked (the `refused` variable from `blocks.take` is false), add `int64(len(v.Message.Content.Text()))` to the byte counter for that tool name. For blocked calls, increment only the call counter.

After the event loop in `run`, read the counters' snapshots into `out.ToolCalls` and `out.ToolResultBytes`. Return nil maps (not empty maps) when no tool calls were made, matching the pattern `toolErrorCounter.snapshot()` uses.
Run TS-13-1 through TS-13-5 and TS-13-38 and confirm they pass.
